reference.note: No Studio MCP implementation source, operation, prompt, resource, schema, or revision is admitted. This file exists so a future Studio MCP server has a defined shape to fill in; it is not a statement that such a server exists, is planned, or is obtainable.

authentication.note: Delegated by construction. Nothing about Studio authentication is admitted, and no credential of any kind appears in this repository.

hostConfigurationMapping.note: Shape only. This mapping is never projected into any host configuration, because the declaration is not resolvable.

distributionBoundary.note: Studio MCP is an extension point only. It is never included in a resolved manifest, never projected into a host configuration, and never shipped in any generated package. skills/cratis-studio-mcp-safety-guidance and catalog/studio-mcp-tool-classifications.json remain the only Studio MCP surface.
